lineage.contribution: jidoka (1924); andon system; structural humility as discipline

intent: Andon gate for diligence access to memoir-register substrate at /substrate/jim-calhoun/letter/. Email-based, social vouching, no technical enforcement.

operator_notes.subject: Kaizen butler
operator_notes.note: This page operates in kaizen-butler mode — calm, helpful, walks-them-through, doesn't gatekeep aggressively. The phrase belongs envelope-only; surface stays understated. The kaizen-butler operating principle applies to all Andon surfaces: respond to the human asking for access with the discipline of a person who knows the building, not the suspicion of a person who guards the door.

operator_notes.subject: Andon yellow
operator_notes.note: Yellow andon-light usage is semantically precise. Green: running. Yellow: supervised, call for help. Red: line stopped. This page is yellow because the system is running and the gate is supervised, not because access is forbidden.

operator_notes.subject: Option C — per-recipient substrate
operator_notes.note: Per-recipient Kegs at /substrate/jim-calhoun/letter/recipients/{name}/ are forthcoming structural work. When mesh density warrants, the gate becomes load-bearing rather than purely social. Until then, the framing does the work.

reserves: Andon ships v1 low-fi: yellow signal, plain prose, email address. Discipline rather than feature. Improves through use.
